Within the intricate matrix system of the collection, it treats the conditional relationships generated by pairing the *kusalattika* (the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states) with the *sekkhattika* (the triad of states pertaining to trainees, those beyond training, and neither) [SuttaCentral].
